newsitem.title: CANADA: CANADA SETTING ECONOMIC SANCTIONS AGAINST BURMA.
newsitem.headline: CANADA SETTING ECONOMIC SANCTIONS AGAINST BURMA.

text.p: Canadian Foreign Minister Lloyd Axworthy scheduled a news conference for Thursday morning to announce sanctions against Burma.
A notice from his department said he would "comment on economic measures against Burma." An official said Axworthy had won approval on Wednesday night to announce the sanctions.
A Canadian spokesman at Asian security talks in Kuala Lumpur said on July 29 that Axworthy would recommend that the Canadian government impose new economic measures aginst Burma.
Canada has already banned development aid and export guarantees for Burma, and has decided to go further to press the Asian nation on human rights and democracy.
